_read_me: The sales page's one settings file (Brad 2026-10-17). News, the show switch, videos and collector quotes live HERE and nowhere else. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, East Coast time. A news item shows from its 'from' date to its 'until' date (both optional); 'ribbon' puts a short line in the bar across the top while it is current. Prices and the item count are NOT here: the page reads them from app/config.js (RR_PRICE_TEXT, RR_SHOW_PRICE_TEXT, BRAND_CATALOG_COUNT). The show dates must match the show dates in the backend's config tab (the app's welcome screen switches on those).

news.title: See us at York
news.text: We will be set up in Orange Hall at the York Train Fair this fall — Friday, October 23 and Saturday, October 24. Stop by for a live demo and the show-only price.
news.ribbon: We will be set up in Orange Hall at York this fall — Fri Oct 23 & Sat Oct 24

news.title: Paste a picture straight in
news.text: On a computer, copy a picture and press Ctrl+V on the Add screen — it drops right into the photo you picked.

news.title: Past reports, ready to send
news.text: Every report you make is kept. Open the list, tap Send, and it goes out by text or email in seconds.

news.title: Full-size photo links when you share
news.text: Share a sale list or a new find and the people you send it to can open every photo at full size.

news.title: Record a sale — and a return
news.text: Mark an item sold with who bought it, where, when and for how much. If it comes back, one tap puts it back in your collection.
